Hi Olivia —

Thanks again for the productive discovery call today. Per our conversation, I wanted to summarize agreed success criteria, the evaluation plan, timelines, owners, and next steps so we have a single source of truth heading into the POC. Attached: "POC_success_criteria_v1.docx" and a starter risk tracker.

Success criteria (high level):
- End-to-end 95th pct latency <= 450ms for 512-token prompts (applies to customer staging traffic profile)
- Inference cost per 1k tokens within 20% of your current baseline (target overall savings)
- No functional regressions on existing prompts (key prompt suite pass rate >= 98%)
- Stable KV cache behavior across sessions (no memory leak/eviction issues during 24h soak)

Evaluation plan & timeline:
- Week 0 (Aug 10): Access granted, environment checklist & pre-flight run (IT to provide connectivity + keys) — owner: Olivia / it-ops
- Week 1 (Aug 11-17): Deploy sample workload, run baseline vs Redwood dedicated instance. Collect perf/cost metrics — owner: Aditya (redwood) + Mark (stellar)
- Week 2 (Aug 18-24): Run stress tests, regression prompt suite, and soak test. Track issues in risk tracker — owner: Neha (redwood)
- Week 3 (Aug 25-28): Review results, adjust config/quantization if needed. Final decision checkpoint Aug 28.

Risk & escalation paths (starter list):
- Blocking SDK integration bug (blocks end-to-end validation) — mitigation: fall back to HTTP + local adapter; escalation to Eng on-call if not resolved in 24h
- Network policy blocking long-lived connections — mitigation: switch to short-poll streaming fallback; engage IT
- Unexpected model divergence/regression — mitigation: pin model version and revert; run immediate eval suite

Next steps (action items):
1) Olivia / it-ops: Share staging hostnames and access method (VPN or peered VPC) by EOD Wed Aug 5
2) Marissa/Redwood: Share final POC config and risk tracker by Mon Aug 10 (attached)
3) Aditya: Prepare baseline job and data template by Aug 10

If any of these timelines don't work or you'd like to add success metrics, let me know and we'll update the doc. Looking forward to getting started.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole

Hi all — quick update after an initial triage.

1) SDK token renewal: we reproduced the 401 when the token-refresh endpoint returned 503 under load; the SDK's current retry window is small and doesn't handle that exhaustion gracefully. Plan: increase retry window + exponential backoff and add a fallback to short-lived service account tokens as an opt-in config. ETA for a release candidate: Aug 7 EOD (we can push a patch into their staging env) or a temporary HTTP adapter and runbook by Aug 6 noon to unblock baseline runs.

2) Regional notes: we'll add EU failover guidance to the tracker (pin model to EU region + explicit routing policy) — Neha will update the doc today.

3) Next steps for IT: Olivia, if you can share the staging hostnames and preferred access pattern (VPN vs VPC peering), Dev will provide the playbook for both flows.

I'll update the attached tracker with the SDK issue row: owner=aditya_rao, status=Investigating, eta=2026-08-07.
